summary: DJR's page for Roslindale, a De Vinne-descended Victorian serif with weight, width, slant and optical-size axes, built with Typetura. A 3D wireframe 'horn' (the family's conical designspace) recurs from the hero to the Family chapter; huge editable chapter words ('History.', 'Family.', 'Utility.') and black interludes of editable word rows that slide sideways with scroll punctuate cream history and in-use collages and a blue run of per-axis explainers, ending in big-type credits and DJR's on-page cart in dark teal.

instances.look: On black, 'When in Doubt, / Use Roslindale' centred in white Display Bold at ~150px over a thin tan wireframe of a tapering box (the designspace 'horn') with a small 'R' marking a corner; four small peach buttons TRIAL, BUY, TYPESET, PDF at the bottom left
instances.ux: The slogan is editable; TRIAL adds the testing licence to the cart, BUY jumps to the cart section, TYPESET opens DJR's typesetting app, PDF downloads the specimen; on load the hero slides up over a teal band (t≈1.6s)
instances.learn: Draw the family's designspace as a quiet wireframe behind the slogan: the diagram becomes the brand graphic before it is explained later

reconstruction.layout: Section 1440×819 below a 33px site header; headline 2 lines centred ~1250px wide around y≈410; wireframe SVG (viewBox 600×700) ~470×520px centred behind; buttons ~56×24px at x≈10, bottom 10px
reconstruction.typography: Headline ~150px Roslindale Display (opsz 48, wdth 100, wght 700), leading ~0.95, white; 'R' ~20px tan; buttons ~9px Input Sans Narrow caps on peach
reconstruction.behaviour: Typetura binds --opsz to the viewport width (clamp 10–48); the section translates on load/scroll (transform: translateY); h1 contenteditable
